uplink.description: Full profile uplink: all 16 levels of the probe string connected, plus battery (flags 0x0003)
uplink._note: Synthetic Decentlab v2 frame (level words chosen for realistic ~22 C readings; level 0 word 34918 -> 21.5 C, levels 1-15 word 34968 -> 22 C, battery word 3300 -> 3.3 V) decoded by the embedded upstream decoder. Every temperature_at_level_N becomes one channels entry labelled level0..level15; whole-device battery stays top-level. Satisfies temperature (membership sees through top-level channels entries).

uplink.description: 11-sensor probe string: levels 0-10 connected, levels 11-15 read the disconnected sentinel and get no entry
uplink._note: reference/upstream-examples.json example 1 (upstream vendor example). Its output has temperature_at_level_0..10 at 27.48/27.06/27.2/26.92/27.39/26.97/27.55/27.33/27.43/27.06/27.21 C and temperature_at_level_11..15 at -327.68 C (word 0x0000, the unconnected-level sentinel, below the vocabulary bound -273.15 C) — expected values taken verbatim from that upstream output. Pins the sentinel policy: the five disconnected levels are skipped, so an 11-sensor string yields 11 entries. Battery word 2812 -> 2.812 V.

uplink.description: Battery-only frame (profile block deselected, flags 0x0002) -> no temperature to report
uplink._note: reference/upstream-examples.json example 2: the sensor-flags bitmap selects only the 1-word battery block, so the embedded decoder returns no temperature_at_level_N at all. Pins the header's policy — a DL-TP frame with no connected level (deselected block, or every level at the -327.68 sentinel) is rejected rather than emitting an empty channels array.
